name: a(n) is the size of the largest subset S of {1,...,N} such that every element of S+S is squarefree.
link: Leandre Jack, Table of n, a(n) for n = 1..3000 (first 700 terms from William Alexander Carney).
William Alexander Carney, Python program (exact branch and bound with mod-4 class decomposition).
Paul Erdős and András Sárközy, On divisibility properties of integers of the form a+a', Acta Math. Hungar. (1987), 117--122.
Leandre Jack, Erdős Problem 1109: exact values of f(N) for N <= 3000, GitHub.
Sergei Konyagin, Problems of the set of squarefree numbers, Izv. Ross. Akad. Nauk Ser. Mat. (2004), 63--90.
program: v = [e for e in list(range(1,n+1)) if is_squarefree(2*e)]
G.add_edges_from((a,b) for a, b in combinations(v,2) if is_squarefree(a+b))
return max(len(c) for c in find_cliques(G)) # _Chai Wah Wu_, Jan 07 2026
